criteria.requirement: Add natsort.cached.cached_natsort_keygen(key=None, alg=ns.DEFAULT, maxsize=128). Each factory owns an independent bounded LRU and exposes cache_info/cache_clear; hashable values are type-separated, unhashable values bypass caching, and exceptions are not cached. Output must match the original configured natsort_keygen. Reject negative/noninteger capacities and active caching of global LOCALE strategies; maxsize=0 disables storage. Mutable external key policy requires explicit cache_clear or a new factory. Default natsort APIs remain unchanged.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
